title: croton lanceolaris
intro: Croton lanceolaris, commonly known as Ashwagandha, is an evergreen shrub native to India and Africa, characterized by its woody stems and yellow flowers. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including reducing stress and anxiety, improving sleep quality, and enhancing cognitive function. The therapeutic actions of Ashwagandha include adaptogenic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its ability to balance the body's response to stress and promote overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of Ashwagandha include withanolides, alkaloids, and saponins, which have been shown to possess anti-inflammatory, anti-cancer, and neuroprotective properties.
